news.title: 20-Year-Old Nathalia Filgueiras Was a Pilot on Learjet That Crashed in Florida
news.summary: Nathalia Filgueiras received a pilot’s license at 17, had logged more than 1,300 hours of flight time and was the co-pilot on Sunday, her mother said in an interview.
